<!-- pr-reviewer: 3b45e3fec14877a0acd5c32bfe34ddc8a33393ae -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: merges at the next cut).

**What looks good**
- Plasma refusals are shared by the parser, the Machines-pane validator and the parsed-form gate (`plasma_refusals` / `Machine::plasma_sane`, crates/post/src/machine/plasma.rs), so the doors cannot disagree. Each names its key (`spindle.max_speed`, `coolants`, `tooling.coolants`, `live_tool`, rotary axis name).
- The machine check (crates/app/src/machine/plasma.rs) judges XY travel and XY feed, and pushes two named `notes` for the skipped Z depth/travel and rpm. A non-plasma op is refused by op kind and family.
- Posting: `PLASMA_POSTS` is empty and `post_serves(_, Plasma)` is false for every built-in post, so no mill post is offered or used. `post_offer` returns nothing for the 1300PL (posting.rs). `family_gate` refuses a mill/turn op on a plasma setup by name, and the verification gate blocks a pre-existing op.
- 1300PL file: X 48.5 / Y 50 / Z 3.9 in, 1000 IPM XY, 120 IPM Z, no rapid, inch. This is the smaller of manual UM10720 §2.2.1 (X50/Y51.5) and the 03/24 spec sheet (X48.5/Y50). `docs/decisions/669-plasma-kind.md` item 7 records the conflict and cites both.
- No `unwrap/expect/panic!` in non-test code (all hits in the diff are in tests). `Kind` and the judge helpers were split out of the files that sat at the 400-line limit. Every touched source file is under 400 lines. New provenance lines are present. The PR touches no build.rs, `.github`, scripts or dependencies.
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #669`. No `CHANGELOG.md` or snapshot PNG edits.

**Local results** (trial merge with `upstream/main`: already up to date, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| plasma_machine | 6 passed |
| machine / machine_library / machine_edit | 32 / 11 / 12 passed |
| tormach_machines / tormach_safe_retract / tormach_post | 5 / 4 / 10 passed |
| posting / conformance / project_roundtrip | 17 / 6 / 69 passed |
| camcraft-post (all) | passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings | clean |
| camcraft-ui --lib | 376 passed, 1 failed: `headless_run_succeeds`, "No suitable graphics adapter found" (no GPU on the review host; environmental, unrelated) |

`tormach_routers` is not on main, so it was not run.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The task spec says kerf = the torch tool's diameter. The PR leaves that to #670 (the torch tool kind), as its "Seams" section says. Nothing in this PR uses a kerf.
2. `posting::MACHINES` is also appended to by #624, #627, #634 and #654, so expect a trivial list merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c63d36a5b642518094615b4d63c8126a45e3ec46 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed head c63d36a, trial-merged with current upstream/main (merged cleanly, no conflicts).

**What looks good**
- Plasma rules sit in one place (`post/src/machine/plasma.rs`) and are enforced at every door (parse, validator, `is_sane`), each refusal named.
- The machine check names what it skips ("not judged") instead of passing it silently. Posting is blocked until #670/#671 give an op and a post, so nothing wrong can be posted.
- No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. No snapshot PNG, `CHANGELOG.md` or `RECOMMENDED.md` edits. Decision record present, provenance headers on the new modules, `mod.rs` shrunk to 396 lines. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #669`. No build.rs, scripts, .github or dependency changes.

**Local results (merged with main, debug)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app --test plasma_machine | 6 passed |
| machine / machine_library / machine_edit | 32 / 11 / 12 passed |
| tormach_safe_retract / tormach_machines | 4 / 6 passed |
| posting / conformance / project_roundtrip / ribbon | 17 / 6 / 71 / 11 passed |
| camcraft-post | all passed |
| camcraft-app --lib | 103 passed |
| camcraft-ui --lib (from crates/ui) | 423 passed, 5 ignored |
| clippy post/app/ui lib+bins, plus the touched app test targets, -D warnings | clean |

Not run: `--all-targets` clippy for camcraft-app, because `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs` does not compile on main (known #686, `missing hand`; not from this PR).

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The PR appends to `posting::MACHINES` like #624/#627/#634/#654, so whichever merges later takes a small list merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
